title: CRIS System — Successor to Metis
notes: European open tender for research information system to replace Metis. Awarded to Vidatum — direct loss for Elsevier Pure. Both Radboud University and Radboud UMC signed. Go-live Q1 2027.

title: Web of Science Licence Non-Renewal
notes: UT decided not to renew Clarivate Web of Science (incl. JCR + ESI). Scopus was explicitly cited as the preferred alternative — UT stated Scopus has broader scope and higher usage. Win by default for Elsevier. Licence ended Dec 31 2025.
source: University of Twente student news, November 2025

title: Web of Science Access Termination
notes: VU Amsterdam terminated Web of Science access effective January 1 2026. Scopus retained as primary bibliometric database. Another Clarivate loss, Scopus wins by default.

title: SURF National Read & Publish + Scopus Deal
notes: 2-year national Read & Publish agreement + Scopus subscription signed Jan 2025 via SURF consortium. Covers all Dutch universities. Optional 3rd-year extension. Renewal negotiations expected late 2026 / early 2027. Key relationship to protect.

title: IReL Framework — ScienceDirect / Scopus / SciVal
notes: TED reference 598844-2025. €42.1M, 72-month open framework tender for Lots covering ScienceDirect, Scopus, SciVal and Knovel. Cancelled — zero responses received. Suggests Elsevier unwilling to compete on open tender format. Watch for re-tender.
